title: 2015 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: What are the sign and units digit of the product of all the odd negative integers strictly greater than \(-2015?\)

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: It is a negative number ending with a \(1.\)

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: It is a positive number ending with a \(1.\)

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text:
It is a negative number ending with a
\(5.\)

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: It is a positive number ending with a \(5.\)

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: It is a negative number ending with a \(0.\)

solutions.text:
There are \(1007\) odd numbers greater than \(-2015.\)

Our product is of an odd number of negative numbers, so the result is negative.

Also, we multiply by \(-5\) in there, so the product is a multiple of \(5,\) making it end in \(5\) or \(0.\) None of our factors are even, so the product can’t be even.

Therefore, the product must end in \(5.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Count how many odd negative factors there are
An odd product with a factor of \(5\) has units digit \(5\)
